output.summary: The 30% revenue decline is mostly explained by the loss of Castellan Hall. Seats fell 40%, and the temporary venue is 6.5 km out with poor transit. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the move year. Lapsed patrons mainly cite travel. The cathedral downtown sold about 1,520 tickets against 1,027 at Brightwater. Comparable orchestras with no venue change fell a median of 29%, so the headline figure is unusual only in its timing and composition, not its size. Repertoire shows no per-concert sales effect in the Brightwater comparison. Committed attenders renew at stable rates, so core defection is not supported. Marketing effect is unestablished because nothing is tracked. Non-renewal is harmful: it risks the $400k/season Halvorsen grant and rests on a weak diagnosis. Present the segmented analysis, use the cathedral dates, and pilot the shuttle.
